parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly states an action: "I suggest presenting these main experimental results in a more compact and coherent way instead of deferring most of them to the appendix." This is a direct suggestion. Moreover, the comment supplies concrete details: it identifies the specific missing results (A-DDIM and PNDM absent from the main text, and quantitative results missing on datasets beyond CIFAR-10) and the specific fix of presenting them in the main text rather than the appendix, so authors know exactly what to add and where. It also points to the missing baselines (A-DDIM, PNDM) and the datasets other than CIFAR-10 whose quantitative results are absent, telling authors precisely which results to include; requiring named metrics and presentation structure goes beyond both the evidence and the rubric's definition of a concrete action. The authors thus know exactly what needs to be done: add the named missing results from the appendix to the main text and present them there in a compact, coherent way, which satisfies the rubric requirement of an explicit action with concrete implementation details.
